Anna wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The plant garden looked quieter than usual that evening. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. For example, the turtle swims slowly in the warm sea.

People around Anna often share different ideas about the plant garden. At first, Anna found it difficult to keep the habit. Anna thanked Lily for the honest advice. What's more, rabbit fencing buries thirty centimetres down.

On Friday evenings, Anna reviews the notes from class. Lily always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Anna prefers snowy weather when running in the gym. Scientists predict a hot summer.

Anna bought a hat online because it was much cheaper. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The five-day outlook stays unsettled.
Anna's dream job is to be a nurse. The city park has become an important part of daily life. Little by little, things began to change.
